
  HARBOR  /  SESSION
  One active session · Protocol-only
  ┃  ctrl+p  Command palette
  ┃  ctrl+x s  Toggle runtime context
  ┃  ?  Keyboard help
  ┃  q  Quit
  ┃  ctrl+x a  Attach file · unavaila
  ┃  ctrl+x k  Cancel queued follow-u
  ┃  ctrl+x e  Remove attachment · un
  ┃  ctrl+x p  Restore stashed draft
  ┃  ctrl+x u  Retry attachment · unao
